subject: Civic Education
lesson: Explains how the emotions impact on personal behaviour in varying ways: Community Observation Checklist & Mapping: Competency 8.2.3
unique_learning_outcome: Explains how the emotions impact on personal behaviour in varying ways.
the_entrance: Detailed 5-minute introduction: teacher and student actions linking prior knowledge to this period topic and activity... Students are introduced to the concept of emotions and their impact on personal behavior. The teacher explains the importance of understanding emotions and their role in shaping our behavior. Students are asked to share their personal experiences with emotions and how they have affected their behavior.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher explains the concept of emotions and their impact on personal behavior. Students are introduced to the community observation checklist and mapping activity.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students review the community observation checklist and mapping activity. They are asked to identify the different types of emotions and how they can be observed in their daily lives.
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Task assignment cards, role description sheets, inquiry scenario prompts

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher circulates as facilitator among groups, observes peer interactions, scaffolds challenging concepts with probing questions, and ensures active participation without lecturing...
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students actively execute the chosen activity (e.g., conducting mock council session, exploratory school-walk survey, analyzing Sri Lankan community issues, or solving civic challenges in groups) using assigned roles...
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_method: Active Student-Centered Investigation / Simulation / Drama / School-Walk
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Worksheets, roleplay cue cards, chart papers, colored markers

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Teacher moderates student presentations, facilitates constructive peer review, and synthesizes key student discoveries directly against the period's learning outcomes...
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Spokespersons present group solutions or roleplay outcomes; class peers ask questions, provide constructive feedback, and summarize key takeaways in their notebooks...
lesson_development_steps.learning_teaching_aids: Student output posters, whiteboard, peer assessment checklist

summary: Consolidation and synthesis of key concepts...
post_activity: 5-minute in-class assignment: Five-minute in-class assignment or concluding task... Students are asked to reflect on what they have learned about emotions and their impact on personal behavior. They are asked to write a short paragraph summarizing their understanding of the topic.

Approach: Students use community observation checklist & mapping to explore 'Explains how the emotions impact on personal behaviour in varying ways.'. Students inspect the provided scenario or accessible surroundings, record evidence, and compare findings. Standard class layout (35 students): Desks arranged into 7 teams (7 teams (7 groups of 5)), with students rotating responsibilities (Leader / Facilitator, Scribe / Secretary, Timekeeper & Logistics, Spokesperson / Presenter, Civic Investigator / Inquirer) without bystanders.
